question.text: What will be the maximum intraday value of the VIX over these biweekly periods in Q4 2026? (Nov 23 - Dec 4)
question.resolution_criteria: Each subquestion will resolve as the maximum intraday value of the VIX recorded from the market open on the first Monday to the market close on the last Friday of the specified biweekly period. Specifically, it will resolve as the highest HIGH value for the relevant days in the CSV published [on the Cboe website](https://www.cboe.com/tradable_products/vix/vix_historical_data/).
question.fine_print:
* If the market is closed on one or more trading days within the period, only the available trading days will be considered.
* If the resolution source delays or ceases its reporting of these data, Metaculus might use alternative [credible sources](https://www.metaculus.com/faq/#definitions) to resolve this question.

## 4. Base rates and seasonality
These are the maximum highs in the CSV for the same Thanksgiving-to-first-Friday-of-December window, compared with the VIX close in mid-November of each year ([Cboe CSV](https://cdn.cboe.com/api/global/us_indices/daily_prices/VIX_History.csv)):

| Year | Window | Mid-Nov close | Window max high | Ratio |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2021 | Nov 22 to Dec 3 | 16.29 (11/12) | **35.32** (12/3, Omicron) | 2.17x |
| 2022 | Nov 21 to Dec 2 | 23.73 (11/14) | **22.63** (11/30) | 0.95x |
| 2023 | Nov 20 to Dec 1 | 14.16 (11/14) | **14.31** (11/20, 11/21) | 1.01x |
| 2024 | Nov 25 to Dec 6 | 16.14 (11/15) | **15.72** (11/25) | 0.97x |
| 2025 | Nov 24 to Dec 5 | 19.83 (11/14) | **23.68** (11/24) | 1.19x |

- Seasonal pattern: the VIX usually drifts down through Thanksgiving week and early December. In 4 of 5 years the window's maximum came on its first day or two, and 2021 is the exception. The window max landed between 0.95x and 1.2x the mid-November level, apart from the 2021 shock year.
- 2026 compared with past years: the current level, about 19 to 21, is above 2023 and 2024, close to 2025, and below 2022. Realized volatility is high. Q4 2026 daily highs have run from about 14.8 to 28.4. Since Oct 14 the VIX has topped 20 intraday on 10 of 23 days in the CSV through Nov 13, and spikes have repeatedly reached 22 to 28 (10/16 at 22.31, 10/30 at 23.93, 11/5 at 28.36).
- Earlier 2026 reference highs: 3/11 at 26.23 and 6/11 at 22.59.

forecasts.reasoning:
(a) **Time left:** The window runs from Mon Nov 23 to Fri Dec 4, 2026. That is 9 trading days, since Nov 26 is closed for Thanksgiving and Nov 27 is a half day. The outcome will be known about 18 days from now, on Dec 4 after the close.

(b) **Latest known value:** The latest row in the Cboe CSV is Nov 13, 2026, with a high of 20.92 and a close of 19.30. Intraday on Nov 16 the VIX was about 21.2. The Q4 high so far is 28.36 on Nov 5.

(c) **If nothing changed:** If the VIX holds around 19 to 21, the maximum high over 9 trading days would likely be about 21 to 22.

(d) **If the current trend continued:** The recent trend is choppy and elevated, with repeated spikes to 22 to 28 and the VIX above 20 intraday on 10 of 23 recent days. Pre-window catalysts include Nvidia earnings, Fed hike pricing, 5%+ long yields, AI stock weakness and the Anthropic IPO. Against that, Thanksgiving seasonality usually pulls the VIX down. Netting these gives a window max of roughly 22 to 24.

(e) **Historical variation:**
- In 4 of the last 5 years, the window max was 0.95 to 1.2 times the mid-November level.
- 2021 was the outlier at 2.17x (Omicron).
- In 4 of 5 years the max came on the first day or two of the window.
- The VIX level a week from now is itself uncertain, with a plausible range of about 16 to 27.

(f) **Experts and markets:**
- The November VIX future is about 19.45, with the curve in contango, so markets expect mild mean reversion.
- VVIX is above 100, which signals a high chance of spikes.
- Kalshi prices about 59% on "Fear" or "Extreme Fear" readings on Dec 4.
- A Fed hike on Dec 9 is fully priced, and the jobs report on Dec 4 falls inside the window.

(g) **Unexpected scenarios:**
- **Low:** Nvidia earnings reassure, the Anthropic IPO goes smoothly and yields ease. A Thanksgiving melt-up then pushes the VIX to about 15 to 16, and the window high is around 16 to 17.
- **High:** The Nvidia leadership crisis and a bond selloff, with the 10-year yield near 5.5%, plus a strong jobs report on Dec 4 that raises the odds of a 50bp hike. That could trigger a correlated deleveraging spike, with the VIX reaching the low-to-mid 30s, or above 40 in a true shock.
